brief.aim: Predict the oestrogen-receptor (ER) status of breast tumours in CPTAC-BRCA from mass-spectrometry protein abundance. Compare several classifiers with cross-validation on the training rows, and report discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis for the selected model.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure observed; sample_id is unique per row (120 unique of 120 rows).
brief.unit: One breast tumour sample (mass-spectrometry proteome profile)
